name: RTL Reward Bench
description: Measures how far RTL graders can be trusted as reinforcement-learning rewards: 8 graders (compile, lint, weak and strong testbenches in Icarus and Verilator, SymbiYosys equivalence, Yosys depth/structure/CDC rules, timed gate-level simulation) on 69 SystemVerilog designs with known bugs. Reward API; CI reproduces every verdict.
